ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alufluoride Limited filed a compliance certificate confirming adherence to SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This certificate, issued by their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, verifies the timely and proper processing of all share dematerialization requests and updates to the register of members. The filing indicates sound corporate governance in share transfer operations with no material impacts or red flags identified.
